items.sentence: Scientists should be people who seek constant improvement and transparency for the benefit of sound, rigorous science.
items.answer: who seek constant improvement and transparency for the benefit of sound, rigorous science
items.explanation: who가 이끄는 절 전체가 선행사 people을 뒤에서 수식합니다.
items.memory: 명사 뒤 who + 동사 → 앞 명사를 설명하는 관계사절

items.sentence: Sometimes we lack the courage to do what we think is right, or we give in to temptation, knowing that we are doing wrong things due to weakness of will.
items.answer: to do what we think is right
items.explanation: to do what we think is right는 ‘옳다고 생각하는 것을 할 용기’라는 뜻으로 the courage를 수식합니다.

items.sentence: New businesses often give the influential people who shape general opinions free samples or an early, inside look at what they are planning, so that they can build buzz and anticipation.
items.prompt: the influential people을 수식하는 관계사절을 드래그하세요.
items.explanation: who shape general opinions가 바로 앞의 the influential people을 수식합니다.
items.structure: give / the influential people [who shape general opinions] / free samples or an early, inside look

items.sentence: I've seen so many people struggle tremendously to fit into boxes or to live up to expectations or pressures put upon them by whatever society's concept of 'normal' is.
items.prompt: see의 목적격보어와 expectations or pressures를 수식하는 과거분사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: put upon them by whatever society's concept of 'normal' is
items.explanation: 지각동사 see 뒤에서 struggle은 목적격보어이고, put upon them ... is는 expectations or pressures를 뒤에서 수식합니다.
items.memory: 동사처럼 보이는 말이 모두 본동사는 아님: 목적격보어·분사 수식을 구별
